T01.rationale: Founded in 2024 by Avtar Sehra as a Laser Digital/WebN venture; the CEO named in April 2026 is Shrey Rastogi. The platform itself has shipped, but the founders' earlier ventures and their outcomes are not documented in the sources.

T03.rationale: Three named executives (CEO Rastogi, COO Dang, CTO Surana since Oct 2025); the founding CEO is no longer named, and headcount is not disclosed.

T04.rationale: A CTO joined in Oct 2025 and the docs describe a role-based registry design, but no public specs, research or code from the technical team were found.

T05.rationale: No VARA notice and no allegations in 2024–26 press coverage; court records, other regulators and wallet history were not checked, so not a 4.

T07.rationale: The KAIO Foundation was set up in Apr 2026 and token voting is promised but not live at TGE; on the platform a KAIO Admin role sits at the top of all permissions.

notes: missing: Foundation/treasury and vesting wallet addresses; the token docs page and Etherscan were not accessible for this review

T09.rationale: Incubated by Laser Digital (Nomura) and WebN (Alan Howard); $19M raised in total; the $8M round in Apr 2026 brought in Tether and Systemic Ventures, with existing investors Further Ventures and Laser Digital (WebN is the incubator, not a round participant). Round terms are undisclosed, and early investors hold 31% of supply.

P01.rationale: Real problem (on-chain access to institutional funds), but two years in, AUM is about $108.5M, against claims of more than $200M issued, so demand looks modest.

P02.rationale: Fund tokens have been live since Mar 2024 on several chains; the AppChain, staking, governance and the KASH retail product are not live at TGE.

P03.rationale: Permissioned register on a sidechain plus an allowlisted mainnet gateway: a standard tokenised-fund design with custom role registries, no published research.

P04.rationale: Off-chain administrator keeps the authoritative register and can rebuild it; on-chain tokens are receipts minted/locked through a gateway, which works but has manual and liveness limits.

P05.rationale: Depends on fund administrators, underlying managers, Circle off-ramp and LayerZero for multi-chain supply; the administrator's off-chain records are the fallback.

notes: No public KAIO GitHub organisation was identified, so the collector was not run.

P08.rationale: Chain launches shipped (Solana, Aptos, Sei), but the $500M Telegram Bond Fund (announced Apr 2025) has no visible launch, and KASH is still on a waitlist that opened Feb 2026.

notes: missing: public code repository and explorer verification of the KAIO token and gateway contracts

P10.rationale: Docs describe registries and access roles but say nothing on upgradeability, admin keys or the KAIO token, and give conflicting asset figures.

notes: audits_reputable_count not set. Docs (KAIO-16, undated) name a Nethermind audit of the platform contracts; the report was not read, and no audit of the KAIO ERC-20 was found. Recorded as a claim (KC4).
missing: the Nethermind report itself (date, scope, commit, findings) and whether it covers deployed gateway and KAIO token contracts
contracts_verified not established, for the same reason (no explorer access). The gateway and fund-registry contracts are also unverified for this review.
upgrade_timelock_hours unknown: upgradeability of the token and gateway contracts is not documented (KAIO-16).
missing: who holds KAIO Admin and token/proxy admin rights, multisig threshold and signers
missing: on-chain read of the KAIO ERC-20 (mint, pause, blacklist, owner). Fund tokens carry allowlist controls by design (KAIO-15).

mint_authority not established. Contract 0x00bac91fd8f5b4a0dc03c8021139b76f6549ee7e (KAIO-06) could not be read: Etherscan, Blockscout and GoPlus were not reachable from this environment. A DexTools scan retrieved on 2026-10-23 reports 'mintable: no, owner renounced'. It was deliberately NOT used, because it postdates the review date. On the day, an analyst would read the verified source on Etherscan.
missing: incident-database check; no exploit appears in 2024–26 coverage, but absence in press is not proof

unreimbursed_exploit_usd not established. No exploit appears in 2024–26 coverage (KAIO-08, -11, -13, -14), but incident databases (rekt.news, DeFiLlama hacks) could not be reached. Absence in press is not treated as evidence.

S09.rationale: Fund token value is set by an independent administrator's daily NAV rather than a market oracle; no on-chain NAV feed or fallback is documented, and KAIO assets are not Horizon collateral.

S10.rationale: Fund tokens move across 10+ chains through a sidechain gateway and LayerZero; the KAIO token itself is a single ERC-20 on Ethereum.

K01.rationale: Governance, product access and planned staking; holders have no right to protocol fees and no buyback or burn exists.

notes: top10_holder_pct_ex_contracts not set: at TGE, supply sits in Foundation, community and vesting wallets, and airdrop claims open on 8 May. Needs labelled holder data on the day.
price_to_last_round_multiple not set: round prices (early investors 31%, pre-TGE sale 3.5%) and the listing price were not found in sources dated on or before 2026-05-06.

market_cap_usd / fdv_usd not set: trading began on listing day (KuCoin 13:00 UTC, Coinbase conditional on liquidity) and no pre-listing price or pre-market quote was found. Later values were deliberately not looked up.
missing: vesting contract addresses and an on-chain reconciliation of the 681.25M TGE circulating supply
No independent on-chain activity, holder or fee-payer data for the fund tokens as of the review date; DeFiLlama and rwa.xyz snapshots for that date could not be retrieved.
tvl_usd ($108.5M) is KAIO's own website figure as relayed by The Block (KAIO-08), not an independent aggregator reading.
missing: on-chain activity data for fund tokens and the airdrop recipient set (claims open 8 May)

O09.rationale: Integrations are mostly chain-foundation launches (Sei, Solana, Aptos, MANTRA) and a lending pilot; KAIO is named in Aave Horizon's network but has no collateral listed there.

notes: Order-book depth, spread, volume, venue share and volatility are unavailable before first trade on 2026-05-06.
missing: no trading history; TGE and first trading are on the review date

M06.rationale: No prior market: KuCoin opens KAIO/USDT the same day as TGE and Coinbase's listing; there is no earlier venue whose diligence can be relied on.

notes: missing: no perpetual market or funding history before listing
missing: DEX pool addresses and LP ownership at launch

M10.rationale: RWA tokenisation has momentum and attracted Tether's investment, but KAIO is a small distributor (~$108.5M AUM), not a sector leader.

notes: Protocol revenue is undisclosed. LUMA charges 15 bps to cover fund expenses (KAIO-15); platform fees are 'planned' (KAIO-05).
missing: protocol revenue; only a 15 bps fund ongoing charge (covering fund expenses) and planned basis-point platform fees are disclosed

B03.rationale: Token holders have no statutory right to fees, and no buyback, burn or distribution is planned.

notes: Treasury runway unknown: $19M raised (KAIO-08); burn and treasury holdings undisclosed.
missing: AUM split by fund as of May 2026 (the site's per-fund TVL widget is not point-in-time)
missing: revenue and burn; the company is funded by $19M of venture capital (KAIO-08)
missing: dated size of the tokenised-fund segment from an independent aggregator as of May 2026
No dated category-share figure for tokenised funds as of May 2026 was obtainable.
missing: KAIO's share of tokenised-fund AUM over the last two quarters

C04.rationale: The moat is relationships via Laser Digital/WebN; the products are feeders that BlackRock and Hamilton Lane do not sponsor or run, so managers could go direct.

C05.rationale: A code fork gets no fund structures, administrators or manager access; but these relationships are not exclusive to KAIO.

C06.rationale: Multi-manager feeder access across 10+ chains is the stated edge; Securitize already brings sponsor-backed funds to the same chains (Apollo on Sei).

notes: missing: listing price/FDV and peer valuations as of 6 May 2026

C08.rationale: Sponsor-backed tokenisers (Securitize) are active on KAIO's chains, and KAIO's BlackRock exposure is unsponsored, so incumbents can absorb the use case directly.

C09.rationale: Hamilton Lane confirms a live feeder; Aave Horizon lists no KAIO collateral, and the $500M Telegram Bond Fund and $100M BTC fund are unverified announcements.

C10.rationale: Adds an RWA-platform governance token to Coinbase's catalogue; Coinbase Prime is already a stablecoin custodian for the LUMA fund. Incremental, not a new segment.

notes: missing: social analytics for X/Telegram as of May 2026
missing: disclosure of paid campaigns and airdrop eligibility criteria published before TGE
No token governance vote exists at TGE (KAIO-05).

D08.rationale: Regular announcements, but asset figures vary across its own materials ($200M live vs ~$100M AUM) with no reconciliation.

D10.rationale: Hamilton Lane and Sei publish joint launches, and Tether invested; Aave names KAIO as a Horizon network partner without live collateral.

L01.rationale: HQ in ADGM, a Singapore VCC fund entity and LibreCo Holdings are identifiable; the issuer of the KAIO token (KAIO Foundation) has no stated jurisdiction.

L02.rationale: Marketed as governance/access with no fee rights; team and investors hold 42% (45.5% with pre-TGE sale buyers), and the platform is centrally administered.

notes: sanctions_exposure unknown: needs venue wallet screening of the deployer, Foundation, vesting and top-holder addresses.

L04.rationale: KAIO holds no licences itself and relies on a MAS-regulated manager and third-party administrators; distribution is said to run under CIMA/MAS frameworks, but no ADGM licence is named.

L05.rationale: No regulator action on VARA's list and none in press coverage; FSRA, MAS and court records were not searched directly.

L06.rationale: No privacy features; fund tokens transfer only between KYC'd, allowlisted investors.

L08.rationale: For LUMA: a segregated Singapore VCC sub-fund with units at J.P. Morgan SE and an EY audit, but bankruptcy remoteness rests on non-reliance opinions. The other feeders' custody structures are not disclosed.

L09.rationale: An independent administrator strikes a daily NAV and EY audits annually, but no published attestation or proof of reserves for the fund tokens was found.

L10.rationale: Fund tokens enforce investor and jurisdiction allowlists; no geographic restrictions were found for the KAIO token's distribution or trading.

gates.title: Unrestricted mint controlled by a single key
gates.why: Supply can be inflated at will; every other number in the report is conditional on one person's restraint.

gates.title: Sanctions / illicit-finance exposure
gates.why: Listing would create direct regulatory liability for the venue.

gates.title: Core contracts not source-verified
gates.why: Nobody outside the team can see what users are interacting with.

gates.title: Unremediated exploit with user losses
gates.why: Users are owed money; listing would expose new users to the same counterparty.

gates.title: Active enforcement action against the project or founders
gates.why: Outcome could force delisting or freeze assets after listing.

gates.title: Upgradeable contracts with no meaningful timelock
gates.why: Logic can change under users with no time to exit.

gates.title: Extreme holder concentration
gates.why: A handful of wallets can set the price; order books will not absorb their exit.

gates.title: Unlock cliff within 90 days
gates.why: More than a quarter of circulating supply unlocks shortly after a listing window.

gates.title: No independent audit
gates.why: Code holding user funds has never been reviewed by a third party.

gates.title: Material misrepresentation
gates.why: Two or more project claims contradicted by observed data — the reviewer cannot rely on anything self-reported.

gates.title: Security pillar failing
gates.why: Average security score below 1.5/4 — structural rather than one-off weakness.

gates.title: Anonymous team with centralised admin powers
Undisclosed market-maker terms
gates.why: Token loans and call options are where post-listing dumps are engineered.

gates.title: Insider-heavy allocation
gates.why: Team and investors hold more than half of supply.

gates.title: Mercenary TVL
gates.why: Most deposits are paid to be there and will leave when incentives stop.

gates.title: Volume implausible versus depth
gates.why: Daily volume more than 100x the ±2% depth is a common wash-trading signature.

claim.statement: Docs FAQ: KAIO has facilitated over $200M in live assets across multiple chains

verdict_reasons: evidence coverage 47% below the 70% needed for a verdict
